about.text: Artisan cheese produced in the Argentine Northwest, mainly the provinces of Catamarca and Tucumán, but also Santiago del Estero, Salta and Jujuy. It is defined as a "fresh product obtained by spinning an acidified paste" and an "intermediate product obtained by coagulation of milk by means of rennet and supplemented or not by the action of specific lactic acid bacteria".
